High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Death Star Tractor Beam (Errata)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (A New Hope, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Death Star Tractor Beam _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mFRZugyjGIS3_9bPy7-Ub2GHCmPv-L3H/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Death Star Tractor Beam _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,196 bytes, SHA-256 <code>7454f7e3cf5b9c5f9be25c9132a1a26eb271856de4e914d7affd37c6d00ae0ce</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited print-ready fan rendition is retained as an explicit qualified comparison at [[Death Star Tractor Beam (Errata)]], not an automatic high-resolution scan of that article’s actual 1998 document entry. The actual published document excerpt is [[:File:ANH-D-Death-Star-Tractor-Beam-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p47-entry.png]]. The original file, TIFF provenance and credit remain.
